sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: To tell a day, start each sentence with its time word and then the verb in the right person: *Reggel ébredünk.* *Délben ebédelünk.* *Délután vásárolunk.* *Este pihenünk.* You know the time words *reggel*, *délután*, *este*, *most* and *ma*; *délben* means “at noon”. With a place too, the order stays time, place, verb.

sections.title: A day for us
rows: In the morning we wake up.

items.english: In the morning we read, in the afternoon we walk.
Today at noon they have lunch in the park.
Do you all shop in the afternoon?

sections.content: Keep the same person all through a day. If you start with *ébredünk*, the next verbs are also “we”: *ebédelünk*, *pihenünk*.
